Package com.irurueta.navigation.inertial

Class INSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimator

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.INSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimator
public class INSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimator extends Object
Calculates position, velocity, attitude and IMU biases using an INS loosely coupled Kalman filter to take into account inertial measurements to smooth results and taking into account an initial position. Every IMU sample provided through update(BodyKinematics, double) is corrected with the currently estimated biases and integrated with the ECEF inertial navigation equations, so that the frame held by this estimator is always the INS solution. A Kalman filter epoch is only run when a position and velocity fix is provided through updatePositionAndVelocity(ECEFPosition, ECEFVelocity, double), which uses the INS solution as the predicted state, the fix as the measurement, and then applies the closed-loop correction to the INS solution. Without fixes this estimator behaves as a pure inertial navigator. This implementation is based on the equations defined in "Principles of GNSS, Inertial, and Multisensor Integrated Navigation Systems, Second Edition" and on the companion software available at: https://github.com/ymjdz/MATLAB-Codes/blob/master/Loosely_coupled_INS_GNSS.m

    • listener

      private INSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimatorListener listener
      Listener to notify events raised by this instance.

    • epochInterval

      private double epochInterval
      Minimum epoch interval expressed in seconds (s) between consecutive Kalman filter epochs. Attempting to provide a position and velocity fix when the interval since the last Kalman filter epoch is less than this value, will be ignored. IMU samples are always integrated regardless of this value.

    • config

      private INSLooselyCoupledKalmanConfig config
      INS loosely coupled Kalman filter configuration parameters (usually obtained through calibration).

    • kinematics

    • correctedKinematics

      private BodyKinematics correctedKinematics
      Contains last provided user kinematics minus currently estimated bias for acceleration and angular rate values.

    • frame

      private com.irurueta.navigation.frames.ECEFFrame frame
      Contains current or initial user position, velocity and attitude. This is the INS solution: it is propagated with every IMU sample and corrected on every Kalman filter epoch.

    • initialConfig

      private INSLooselyCoupledKalmanInitializerConfig initialConfig
      Configuration containing uncertainty measures to set initial covariance matrix within estimated state. Once this estimator is initialized, covariance will be updated with new provided INS measurements until convergence is reached.

    • state

      private INSLooselyCoupledKalmanState state
      Current Kalman filter state containing current INS estimation along with Kalman filter covariance error matrix.

    • lastStateTimestamp

      private Double lastStateTimestamp
      Timestamp expressed in seconds since epoch time when Kalman filter state was last propagated (i.e. timestamp of the last Kalman filter epoch).

    • firstKinematicsTimestamp

      private Double firstKinematicsTimestamp
      Timestamp expressed in seconds since epoch time of the first IMU sample (body kinematics) that was provided to this estimator. The first Kalman filter epoch propagates the covariance over the interval elapsed since this timestamp.

    • setFrame

      public void setFrame(com.irurueta.navigation.frames.ECEFFrame frame) throws com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException
      Sets ECEF frame containing current or initial user position, velocity and attitude. Provided instance is kept (not copied) and is updated in place as IMU samples are integrated and Kalman filter corrections are applied. If the Kalman filter state has already been initialized, its position, velocity and attitude are synchronized with provided frame, while its estimated biases and covariance are preserved.
      Parameters:
      frame - ECEF frame containing current or initial user position, velocity and attitude to be set.
      Throws:
      com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException - if this estimator is already running.

    • getInitialConfig

      public boolean getInitialConfig(INSLooselyCoupledKalmanInitializerConfig result)
      Gets initial INS loosely coupled Kalman configuration to set a proper initial covariance matrix during the first Kalman filter propagation. Once this estimator is initialized, covariance will be updated with new provided INS measurements until convergence is reached.
      Parameters:
      result - instance where configuration data will be stored.
      Returns:
      true if result instance was updated, false otherwise.

    • update

      public boolean update(BodyKinematics kinematicsParam, com.irurueta.units.Time timestamp) throws com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException, com.irurueta.navigation.NotReadyException, INSException
      Updates specific force and angular rate applied to the user's body expressed in coordinates resolved along body-frame axes. Every provided sample is corrected with the currently estimated biases and integrated with the ECEF inertial navigation equations over the interval elapsed since the previous sample, regardless of the epoch interval, so that the frame (and the Kalman filter state) always hold the INS-propagated solution. The first provided sample only initializes the Kalman filter state and sets the time reference: no navigation is performed for it. Samples whose timestamp is not greater than the timestamp of the previous sample are ignored. This method does not run any Kalman filter epoch. Use updatePositionAndVelocity(ECEFPosition, ECEFVelocity, double) to provide a position and velocity fix.
      Parameters:
      kinematicsParam - kinematics applied to body (specific force and angular rate) during last period of time. These measures are obtained from an inertial unit (IMU). If null, no navigation is performed and only the time reference is updated.
      timestamp - timestamp since epoch time when specific force and angular rate values were updated.
      Returns:
      true if the sample was integrated, false if it was ignored because its timestamp is not greater than the timestamp of the previous sample.
      Throws:
      com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException - if this estimator is already running.
      com.irurueta.navigation.NotReadyException - if this estimator is not ready to be updated.
      INSException - if estimation fails due to numerical instabilities.

    • updatePositionAndVelocity

      public boolean updatePositionAndVelocity(com.irurueta.navigation.frames.ECEFPosition position, com.irurueta.navigation.frames.ECEFVelocity velocity, double timestamp) throws com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException, com.irurueta.navigation.NotReadyException, INSException
      Provides a position and velocity fix (e.g. a GNSS solution) and runs a Kalman filter epoch. The INS-propagated solution held by this estimator is used as the predicted state, provided fix is used as the measurement, the interval since the last Kalman filter epoch is used as the propagation interval (on the first epoch, the interval since the first IMU sample, or zero if none was provided), and the latest bias-corrected specific force is used to build the transition matrix. Once the epoch is solved, the closed-loop correction is applied to the INS solution (frame) and estimated biases are updated. The fix is compared against the INS solution at the time of the last provided IMU sample (see getLastKinematicsTimestamp()), which is not advanced or moved back to provided timestamp. For best accuracy, a fix must be provided right after the IMU sample whose timestamp is closest to the timestamp of the fix: otherwise the distance travelled between both timestamps is attributed to INS errors. Call to this method will be ignored if the interval between provided timestamp and the timestamp of the last Kalman filter epoch is not positive or is less than the epoch interval. A fix arriving exactly one epoch interval after the previous epoch is accepted.
      Parameters:
      position - ECEF position of the fix.
      velocity - ECEF velocity of the fix.
      timestamp - timestamp expressed in seconds since epoch time when the fix was obtained.
      Returns:
      true if the Kalman filter epoch was run, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException - if this estimator is already running.
      com.irurueta.navigation.NotReadyException - if estimator is not ready for measurements updates.
      INSException - if estimation fails due to numerical instabilities.

    • propagate

      @Deprecated public boolean propagate(com.irurueta.units.Time timestamp) throws com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException, com.irurueta.navigation.NotReadyException, INSException
      Deprecated.
      Kalman filter epochs are run by updatePositionAndVelocity(ECEFPosition, ECEFVelocity, Time). Once the Kalman filter state has been initialized this method makes no action.
      Ensures that the Kalman filter state held by this estimator is initialized and synchronized with the current INS solution (frame). This method no longer runs a Kalman filter epoch: an epoch needs a position and velocity measurement, and is now triggered by updatePositionAndVelocity(ECEFPosition, ECEFVelocity, Time). No listener is notified by this method.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - timestamp since epoch. It is ignored.
      Returns:
      always false, since no Kalman filter measurement update is possible without a position and velocity fix.
      Throws:
      com.irurueta.navigation.LockedException - if this estimator is already running.
      com.irurueta.navigation.NotReadyException - if estimator is not ready for measurements updates.
      INSException - never thrown. Kept for backwards compatibility.

    • isEpochRejected

      static boolean isEpochRejected(double timestamp, double lastStateTimestamp, double epochInterval)
      Indicates whether a Kalman filter epoch at provided timestamp must be rejected because the interval elapsed since the previous epoch is not positive or is less than the epoch interval. An interval equal to the epoch interval is accepted, up to the rounding errors of provided timestamps.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - timestamp of the epoch expressed in seconds (s).
      lastStateTimestamp - timestamp of the previous epoch expressed in seconds (s).
      epochInterval - minimum interval between epochs expressed in seconds (s).
      Returns:
      true if epoch must be rejected, false otherwise.

    • initInitialConfig

      private void initInitialConfig()
      Initializes initial INS loosely coupled Kalman configuration to set a proper initial covariance matrix. This method makes no action if an initial configuration already exists.

    • initState

      private void initState()
      Initializes Kalman filter state from the current frame and the initial configuration (which determines the initial covariance). This method makes no action if state is already initialized.
